description: Fault fixtures used by `npm run validate` and reproducible by hand (see docs/OPERATIONS.md).

scenarios.name: later-batch-service-down
steps: POST /ops/advance            -> batch 1 (currency) effective
POST /ops/pause
stop instance archive-store-1 (only batch 3 needs it)
POST /ops/advance            -> 409 paused (no silent advance while paused)
POST /ops/resume
POST /ops/advance            -> batch 2 (search) effective despite archive-store being down
start instance archive-store-1

scenarios.name: instance-level-readiness
steps: stop instance fx-math-1 (fx-math still has fx-math-2)
POST /ops/advance            -> batch 1 effective; blocked list empty
stop the last remaining instance of a batch's service
POST /ops/advance            -> 409 blocked naming only that service
start the instance again

scenarios.name: coordinator-crash
steps: kill -9 coordinator
start coordinator            -> GET /admin/state?detail=1 shows recovered=true
POST /ops/advance            -> continues from actual batch progress

scenarios.name: coordinator-crash-mid-switch
steps: POST /ops/advance?fault=committed  -> process exits after entries committed, before bookkeeping
start coordinator            -> successor re-reads entries, adopts the committed epoch
GET /admin/state?detail=1    -> batch effective, no duplicate work

scenarios.name: rollback-with-inflight
steps: POST /accept (currency) x N  -> accepted under current version, long delay
POST /ops/pause
POST /ops/rollback
POST /ops/rollback/confirm   -> succeeds while requests still executing
GET /requests/:id            -> in-flight requests still return the version pinned at acceptance

scenarios.name: instance-failover-inflight
steps: POST /submit (currency)      -> entry pins to one fx-tag instance
POST /accept (currency) x N  -> requests enter the delayed fx-tag segment
kill -9 <that fx-tag instance>
GET /requests/:id            -> requests finish on the sibling instance, pinned version, recovered=true

scenarios.name: lost-receipt-cross-instance-reuse
steps: POST <fx-tag instance>/admin/fault {mode:'crash-after-journal'}
POST /accept (currency)      -> branch segment is durably written, then the instance exits before replying
entry retries on the sibling instance
GET /requests/:id            -> fx-tag segment has reused=true, originInstance=<dead instance>,
output equals the pinned-version oracle; join and fx-final still run on v2

scenarios.name: service-restart-recovery
steps: POST /accept (currency)      -> request enters a delayed segment
kill -9 <service instance>
start <service instance>     -> boot heals journaled pending units it owns
GET /requests/:id            -> result matches the version pinned at acceptance

scenarios.name: entry-crash-cross-entry-retry
steps: POST entry-a /accept         -> accepted and running
kill -9 entry-a
POST entry-b /retry {requestId} -> resumes from the shared ledger with the pinned version
GET entry-b /requests/:id    -> correct result, retries >= 1

scenarios.name: single-instance-deployment
steps: use fixtures/topology-single.json (only `port`, no `instances`)
start coordinator + one entry + services (no --instance flag needed)
POST /submit {group:'currency',input:5} -> done on v1 with the correct oracle result
